# Existing branch creation uses the real binary, real Git, and exact focus reuse.
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project branch feature/selected
exec zwm -C project wco feature/selected
cmpenv stdout created
! stderr .

exec zwm -C project wco feature/selected
cmpenv stdout focused
! stderr .

assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- created --
worktree_path=$ZWM_TEST_SELECTED_PATH
display_identity=feature/selected
tab_action=created
tab_title=project:feature/selected
tab_worktree=$ZWM_TEST_SELECTED_PATH
-- focused --
worktree_path=$ZWM_TEST_SELECTED_PATH
display_identity=feature/selected
tab_action=focused
tab_title=project:feature/selected
tab_worktree=$ZWM_TEST_SELECTED_PATH
-- want-log --
